data.summary: 1 working default(s) of 1 Insight(s), 1 of them mandatory, and 0 caution(s). Mandatory must be followed. A working default is settled unless a new review says otherwise. Anything not listed is advisory: citable, not settled. Disputed, rejected, and superseded Insights are unusable without a new review.

working_defaults.title: One engine, one transaction, one close
working_defaults.excerpt: Every bdc invocation opens one short-lived engine and closes it before it returns. Reads state the freshness of anything cached, and a handoff never refreshes.
